//hosting: Set Hosting__BehindProxy=true ONLY where a reverse proxy owns the certificate and this process is unreachable except through it (deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml does not publish the API port). It makes the app trust X-Forwarded-Proto/-For from any caller and stop redirecting to https itself, because Caddy already did both.
//: Shape only. Real values come from environment variables in staging and production: Storage__Endpoint, Storage__AccessKey, Storage__SecretKey, Storage__Bucket, Auth__DeviceToken, Stt__Azure__Key, Stt__Azure__Region, Anthropic__ApiKey, Reporting__Smtp__Host, Reporting__Smtp__Username, Reporting__Smtp__Password, Reporting__FromAddress, Hangfire__DashboardUser, Hangfire__DashboardPassword. Startup fails if the storage ones are missing. Auth__DeviceToken is NO LONGER required: it is the demo device's token, hashed into a real device row by `seed`, and an empty value simply provisions no demo device (announced once at start-up). The AI keys deliberately do not stop the host either; they park entries in needs_review.
//auth: Auth__DeviceToken is the DEMO DEVICE's bearer token, not the authentication system. `seed` provisions a device row whose token_hash is SHA-256 of it, so the token compiled into the PWA bundle authenticates as a genuine device bound to a genuine worker. Empty means no demo device.
//reporting: B6. Reporting__Smtp__Host / __Username / __Password and Reporting__FromAddress come from environment variables. NEVER point this at port 25 on the VPS: Hetzner blocks outbound 25 by default and a fresh VPS IP has no sending reputation, so the report that IS the product lands in the client spam folder. Use an authenticated relay on 587 (StartTls) or 465 (SslOnConnect), and publish SPF, DKIM and DMARC for the FromAddress domain. An unconfigured relay does not stop the host booting; it stops confirmed entries with delivery_not_configured.
